_comment: Forge crafting orbs (docs/forge-currency.md). Each orb: an item (entry 60001+, below the generated pools at 1,000,000, above item_template's 56806) and its Use: spell (101000 + entry - 60000), a copy of 'clone' (46594, Enchant Chest - Defense: item-target cursor, enchant sparkle) with enchant 0 and 'spell_set' changed; spell_forge_orb does the work by 'kind' (and 'arg': an essence's affix id). drop_weight: share of orb drops (common 100, uncommon 30, rare 8, essences 2 each, very rare 2; 0: not an orb drop, e.g. Sands of Nozdormu, which drops only from Unique bosses). Rebuild: docs/forge-currency.md, 'Adding an orb'.

orbs.name: Orb of Upheaval
orbs.use: Rerolls every affix on a Rare, Epic or Legendary forged item. The item keeps its quality.
orbs.description: The Twisting Nether does not care what you wanted.

orbs.name: Shard of Awakening
orbs.use: Awakens a plain weapon or piece of armor, giving it the fewest affixes its quality allows.
orbs.description: Even crafted iron remembers what it could have been.

orbs.name: Shifting Prism
orbs.use: Rerolls every affix on an Uncommon forged item.
orbs.description: Turn it to the light. Turn it again.

orbs.name: Mote of Augmentation
orbs.use: Adds one affix to an Uncommon forged item that has room for another.

orbs.name: Scouring Dust
orbs.use: Strips every affix from a forged item, leaving the plain base.

orbs.name: Alchemist's Catalyst
orbs.use: Awakens a plain weapon or piece of armor with the most affixes its quality allows.

orbs.name: Gambler's Coin
orbs.use: Awakens a plain weapon or piece of armor at a random quality. Rarely, it becomes Legendary, or the Unique of its base.

orbs.name: Sovereign Orb
orbs.use: Raises a forged item one quality step (Uncommon to Rare, Rare to Epic) and adds an affix.

orbs.name: Void Shard
orbs.use: Removes one random affix from a forged item.
orbs.description: What the Void takes, it does not give back.

orbs.name: Felfire Orb
orbs.use: Corrupts a forged item or a Unique, with an unpredictable result. Corrupted items cannot be changed again.

orbs.name: Tear of the Naaru
orbs.use: Keeps the affixes of a forged item or a Unique and rerolls their values.
orbs.description: The Light weighs all things anew.

orbs.name: Eye of the Titans
orbs.use: Adds one affix to a Rare, Epic or Legendary forged item that has room for another.

orbs.name: Essence of the Bear
orbs.use: Rerolls a plain or forged weapon or piece of armor, guaranteeing Strength of the highest grade.

orbs.name: Essence of the Falcon
orbs.use: Rerolls a plain or forged weapon or piece of armor, guaranteeing Agility of the highest grade.

orbs.name: Essence of the Mammoth
orbs.use: Rerolls a plain or forged weapon or piece of armor, guaranteeing Stamina of the highest grade.

orbs.name: Essence of the Savant
orbs.use: Rerolls a plain or forged weapon or piece of armor, guaranteeing Intellect of the highest grade.

orbs.name: Essence of the Owl
orbs.use: Rerolls a plain or forged weapon or piece of armor, guaranteeing Spirit of the highest grade.

orbs.name: Essence of the Warlord
orbs.use: Rerolls a plain or forged weapon or piece of armor, guaranteeing Attack Power of the highest grade.

orbs.name: Essence of the Archmage
orbs.use: Rerolls a plain or forged weapon or piece of armor, guaranteeing Spell Power of the highest grade.

orbs.name: Sands of Nozdormu
orbs.use: Raises a Unique below level 60 to level 60, with stats, armor and damage to match.
orbs.description: Dropped only by bosses that guard a Unique. What it would have become, given time.
